source.edition: 1925年文明書局本（项目固定版本）
source.hash_status: inherited project reference; not recomputed this turn

method: Direct visual review of 11 relevant scan screenshots (zero-based 2–6 and 14–19). Bilingual thematic paraphrases, not exact transcription or Cangjie output. Diagram companion records deliberately distinguished from earlier text summaries.

records.summary_en: A labeled atlas of traditional facial locations; it is a terminology reference, not a prediction.
records.summary_zh: 传统面部部位总图，用于术语定位，不是预测结果。

records.summary_en: The diagram labels facial regions with historical year numbers; it is a separate age-indexed symbolic system.
records.summary_zh: 流年图以年龄数字标注部位，属于独立的年龄取象体系。

records.summary_en: The palace diagram organizes traditional life topics spatially, distinct from the age diagram.
records.summary_zh: 十二宫图以空间位置组织传统人生主题，与流年图不同。

records.section: 五星六曜五嶽四瀆之圖
records.summary_en: Several astronomical and geographical naming conventions share a single illustration.
records.summary_zh: 五星六曜、五岳、四渎等不同取象名称并列于同一图。

records.summary_en: The diagram gives a visual companion to the existing six-region and three-section text archive.
records.summary_zh: 六府三才三停图作为既有文字档案的图示补充。

records.summary_en: A separate diagram combines geographical, trigram and calendrical terminology; it does not establish an independent I Ching source.
records.summary_zh: 九州八卦干支图并列地理、卦象与干支术语，不等同已核对《易经》原文。

records.summary_en: The four and eight halls share an illustration, but their names and scope should be kept distinct.
records.summary_zh: 四学堂与八学堂同图展示，名称与范围仍应分别记录。

records.summary_en: The five offices diagram is a visual reference for the historical five-organ terminology.
records.summary_zh: 五官图提供传统五官名称的图示定位。

records.summary_en: The opening part of the mnemonic enumerates named regions in order; it complements the atlas rather than providing a biography.
records.summary_zh: 十三部位总图歌前段依次列举部位名称，是图谱文字补充。

records.summary_en: The middle part continues the named-region sequence across the nose and adjacent areas.
records.summary_zh: 歌诀中段继续列举鼻部及周边名称。

records.summary_en: The closing portion completes the thirteen-region sequence before the annual-fortune mnemonic begins.
records.summary_zh: 本页先结束十三部位序列，再进入流年歌，不应混作同一段。

records.summary_en: The opening verse introduces age sequencing and a historical sex-based left/right convention; neither is a validated modern measurement.
records.summary_zh: 流年歌开头引入年龄序列及旧式男女左右区别，均不是现代测量标准。

records.summary_en: The middle passage continues its year-by-year symbolic location sequence, distinct from the broad three-section framework.
records.summary_zh: 中段延续逐年部位取象，与粗略三停阶段不同。

records.summary_en: The concluding passage extends the symbolic sequence into advanced age and describes a cycle beyond a century.
records.summary_zh: 末段延伸至高龄，并述及百岁之后的循环观念。

records.summary_en: The closing verse combines several historical concepts, including mountains, rivers and complexion; location alone is not the whole textual context.
records.summary_zh: 结尾并论五岳、四渎和气色等传统概念，不宜把部位单独抽离为完整断语。

records.summary_en: The mnemonic uses elemental categories and different ordering conventions; this is not simply the preceding annual location list.
records.summary_zh: 运气口诀采用五形及不同顺逆次序，与前面的逐年部位列表有别。

records.summary_en: A separate mnemonic discusses age limits and positional comparisons, requiring its own context when cataloged.
records.summary_zh: 识限歌另论年龄限运及部位对照，归档时须独立保留上下文。

limitations: No individual age-event mapping, personal prediction or personality inference.
No independently verified transcription; no model run or runtime change.
Prior batches not reverified this turn.
